lede: The big one to watch this week is Thursday's joint work session where the Planning Commission and Board of County Commissioners dig into proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations, plus condominium plats — five sections of code that shape how this county grows and what gets built or drilled here. Wednesday evening the commissioners also head to Norwood for a rare West End meeting to consider a Planning Commission appointment and hear results from the Placerville Fire Survey. The Ecology Commission is meanwhile revisiting the 2022 Climate Action Plan, zeroing in on transportation, land use, and consumption.

notable.stake: Commissioners may appoint a Planning Commission member who decides close land-use votes.
